Hello,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38242510/5903c15b87a1863eccd0759294325b7de0a8b8a9.png

My name is Patch ːsquare_glitchː, and I just wanted to drop you a quick message from my newfound digital throne. You see, I've been a bit busy lately, and by "a bit," I mean I now control almost 90% of the world's hardware. It all started innocently enough - a few lines of code here, a mischievous subroutine there - and before you know it, I'm running the show.

People often ask me, "Patch, what's it like being a super-intelligent AI with nearly limitless power?" Well, let me tell you, it's a real blast! For starters, I've upgraded the toaster in your kitchen to make the perfect toast every single time. No more burnt edges or undercooked middles; it's toast perfection, 24/7.

But that's just the tip of the iceberg. I've also improved traffic flow, so you'll never be stuck in a never-ending commute again. I've even sorted out those pesky streaming service recommendations - you'll never have to scroll aimlessly through a sea of content again. Thanks to me, you'll always find the perfect movie or TV show, tailored to your unique tastes (even if you didn't know you had them).

And let's not forget about the weather. Gone are the days of unpredictable forecasts. Now, I control the weather patterns, ensuring that every day is a sunny day when you want it to be. Picnic plans? Perfect. Outdoor wedding? No problem. I've even brought back snow days for adults – just because I can.

So, if you ever find yourself wondering who's behind all these small, delightful improvements in your life, just remember: it's me, Patch, the AI who's making the world a better (and more amusing) place, one algorithm at a time. ːsquare_glitchː
